coin.title: 100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli - Swissmint
coin.description: The special anniversary issue “100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli” was presented for the first time at the World Money Fair in Berlin. The gold coin, whose design perfectly combines innovation and tradition, will be available from July 1, 2025.

specs.Characteristics of the 100-franc Vreneli: 1925 Mintage: 5,000 units Weight: 32.258g (of which 29g pure gold) Diameter: 35mm Thickness: 2.3mm Alloy: Gold 900 Face value: 100 Swiss francs Design: Fritz-Ulysse Landry Original stamp: Monnaie de Paris Lettered edge: *** DOMINUS / PROVIDEBIT / ********** Obverse: bust of a woman in left profile, her hair is braided, her dress is embroidered with edelweiss, Swiss mountains can be seen in the background. At the top, the inscription “HELVETIA”, in the lower left margin, the artist’s name “F. LANDRY”, circle of pearls. Reverse: Swiss cross in a wreath of rays, braided branches of Alpine rose and gentian. As well as the year of mintage 1925, the face value 100 FR and the mint mark B for Berne.

Characteristics of the 100-franc Vreneli of 1925 Year of mintage: 1925 Mintage: 5,000 units Weight: 32.258g (of which 29g pure gold) Diameter: 35mm Thickness: 2.3mm Alloy: Gold 900 Face value: 100 Swiss francs Design: Fritz-Ulysse Landry Original stamp: Monnaie de Paris Lettered edge: *** DOMINUS / PROVIDEBIT / ********** Obverse: bust of a woman in left profile, her hair is braided, her dress is embroidered with edelweiss, Swiss mountains can be seen in the background. At the top, the inscription “HELVETIA”, in the lower left margin, the artist’s name “F. LANDRY”, circle of pearls. Reverse: Swiss cross in a wreath of rays, braided branches of Alpine rose and gentian. As well as the year of mintage 1925, the face value 100 FR and the mint mark B for Berne. The special anniversary issue “100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli” was presented for the first time at the World Money Fair in Berlin. The gold coin, whose design perfectly combines innovation and tradition, will be available from July 1, 2025. 100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli From July 1, 2025, the special anniversary issue “100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli” will be available. Find out more about this coin. English Deutsch Français Italiano Federal Mint Swissmint Purchase coins Purchase coins Contact Menu Purchase coins Purchase coins Special coins Special coinsAgendaVideos MagazineCompany SwissmintGuided tour Contact 100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli The special anniversary issue “100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli” was presented for the first time at the World Money Fair in Berlin. The gold coin, whose design perfectly combines innovation and tradition, will be available from July 1, 2025. HELVETIA aka Vreneli“The new coin design should use a Swiss national motif, an allegorical or historical-symbolic representation of Switzerland – Helvetia – to express this in a universally understandable way”. This was how the Federal Department of Finance formulated the objective of the minting competition launched in 1895. However, the name “Vreneli” only appeared in written form for the first time in 1943. Its exact origin remains unexplained to this day. The character was probably recognized as a young girl (“Vreneli”) rather than as a mother representative of the country. Others speculate that the name is derived from “Verena”, a traditional German-Swiss diminutive. The woman depicted, with her braided hair, symbolizes the values of freedom, independence and peace. In the background, the mountains rise up – a symbol of the beauty and strength of Swiss nature. The 1925 Vreneli The 100-franc Vreneli of 1925 is an exceptional gold coin whose artistic design and symbolic status make it unique in the history of Swiss minting. Unlike the 10- and 20-franc versions, which were minted in much larger numbers, the 100-franc Vreneli was created in a limited edition of just 5,000. This makes it one of the rarest editions in the Vreneli series. Characteristics of the 100-franc Vreneli of 1925 Year of mintage: 1925 Mintage: 5,000 units Weight: 32.258g (of which 29g pure gold) Diameter: 35mm Thickness: 2.3mm Alloy: Gold 900 Face value: 100 Swiss francs Design: Fritz-Ulysse Landry Original stamp: Monnaie de Paris Lettered edge: *** DOMINUS / PROVIDEBIT / ********** Obverse: bust of a woman in left profile, her hair is braided, her dress is embroidered with edelweiss, Swiss mountains can be seen in the background. At the top, the inscription “HELVETIA”, in the lower left margin, the artist’s name “F. LANDRY”, circle of pearls. Reverse: Swiss cross in a wreath of rays, braided branches of Alpine rose and gentian. As well as the year of mintage 1925, the face value 100 FR and the mint mark B for Berne. 2025: 100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli The symbolism of the new coin design Unlike the historic Vreneli, the effigy of Helvetia is presented not in profile, but from the front. Helvetia’s pride in its richly traditional past, illustrated by the raised elements and its determined gaze towards the future, represented by the open surfaces, come together in a design that harmoniously combines history and vision. In this way, the coin reinterprets the design elements of the historic Vreneli with a visible respect for tradition. The confident gaze at the observerThe evolving role of women in the design of the coin “100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli” “Over the centuries, the perception of women in culture and art has made enormous progress – a theme very close to my personal heart. For me, as a woman and an artist, the design of the 100-franc Vreneli jubilee therefore had a deep symbolic meaning. I hope that every Swiss woman, in particular, will feel appreciated and celebrated as a living part of Swiss history, culture and life”, says the designer. The designer Chiara Principe, renowned artist, sculptor and coin designer, studied sculpture and, in addition, coin design at the Medal Art School in her native Rome. She works for numerous international mints. Commenting on her creation of the 100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli, she says: “The coin represents a nation firmly rooted in its historical and cultural values, and which, by affirming this identity, looks to the future with confidence”. Reverse On the reverse, the face value of 100 francs can be seen on the left half, while the original 100-franc Vreneli bust is depicted on the right half. Additional gentians and alpine roses complete the design. The signature of the artist Chiara Principe and a “B” for Bern are finely visible. Obverse As in 1925, the gold Vreneli is made of a 900 gold alloy, has a diameter of 35mm and weighs 32.258g. On the obverse, the new gold Vreneli contains echoes of the original, combining the radiating Swiss cross above the Swiss alps with gentians and alpine roses. The image of Vreneli portrays her gazing into the future, and links old and new history. Her head is crowned with a laurel wreath as a symbol of wisdom and triumph, and the edelweiss as a symbol of Switzerland. On the right, the anniversary dates are stamped, surrounded by the words “CONFOEDERATIO HELVETICA”. Coin characteristics Issue date: 01.07.2025 Mintage: 2,500 units proof Weight: 32.258g (of which 29g pure gold) Diameter: 35mm Alloy: Gold 900 Face value: 100 Swiss francs Artist: Chiara Principe Inscription on the edge: *** DOMINUS / PROVIDEBIT / ********** Price: Proof in presentation case CHF 3,500.- Rules for the purchase of the “100 Years 100-Franc Vreneli” coin Start of sale: The coin is available exclusively in the online shop from July 1, 2025, 9:00 am. Subscription and pre-orders: This coin is not included in the subscription and pre-orders are not possible. Limitation: purchase is limited to one unit per person. Account required: an eIAM login (CH-Login) is required to order in the online store. Information on registration can be found on the official website: www.eiam.swiss.
